name: Nightmare Premium
source:
There is a prestigious private school with long history and in good standing. Students there receive top quality education and are considered to be hope of the nation. Main character is determined to seduce and enslave one of the purest girls there.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-december-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
有一所历史悠久、信誉良好的私立名校。那里的学生接受高质量的教育，被认为是国家的希望。主角决心引诱并奴役那里最纯洁的女孩之一。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-december-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
